newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paribas cuts recommendation on Alcatel.
newsitem.headline: Paribas cuts recommendation on Alcatel.

text.p: Paribas Capital Markets said on Wednesday that it cut its recommendation on the stock of electrical engineering group Alcatel Alsthom to sell from no action after an analysts' meeting on Monday.

"After the preliminary results and orderbook announcements last week, and subsequent 20 percent rise in share price, the analysts' meeting yesterday to discuss the development of the telecom activities was an anticlimax," Paribas said in a stock comment sent to clients on Tuesday.
Alcatel shares were trading 0.19 percent higher at 537 francs on Wednesday after a drop of 1.11 percent on Tuesday.

Paribas said the 21 percent rise in the orderbook led to a view that Alcatel had successfully repositioned itself in the marketplace. "This we considered premature and the analysts' meeting confirmed our views," it said.
"We expect the shares to continue to be volatile, particularly given the prospect of Alcatel rebidding for Thomson-CSF," it said.

Alcatel has said it is joining with Aerospatiale and Dassault Aviation to bid for the defence electronics firm when the terms of the privatisation are announced. They are expected to be announced this month.
